Esbjerg is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report utilizes data from Esbjerg, alongside the other 97 Danish municipalities, to benchmark clinical quality and outcomes in atrial fibrillation treatment at the local level [^src1]. Specifically, Esbjerg's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. 

Because the source document is a statistical registry report, Esbjerg is mentioned strictly in a tabular data context on page 94, which details patient counts, event rates, and confidence intervals for the municipality [^src1]. There are no narrative claims, timeline events, or related entities associated with Esbjerg in this corpus; its presence is entirely quantitative.
